items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the meeting of the relative assassin with the closed fibre along a closure at source lines 997-1006, label lemma-associated-point-specializes, whose proof occupies source lines 1008-1028. The proof reduces the statement to the case of schemes through an etale chart, and the reduction is where the content lies: one must lift a specialisation from the space to the chart, which uses the decentness of the space, and one must recognise the lifted point as a point of the relative assassin of the pulled back module, which uses the description of the relative assassin through the associated points of the fibres. The schemes version is then applied inside the chart, and the resulting point is pushed back down to give an associated point of the original closed fibre in the closure. The counted statement records neither the lift nor the identification of the relative assassin.
